original: Create a production sprite sheet for TWO DIFFERENT enemy ice fighter jets for a premium Neo Geo style HD arcade vertical shooter. The reference is a modular cryogenic miniboss hull; these are smaller aircraft from that same navy/silver/cyan industrial faction, not copies of that carrier. FRAME FORMAT: exactly 32 poses in a 4-column by 8-row grid. Each equal 256x256 cell, identical scale and fixed cockpit anchor within each bank. Transparent background, absolutely no text or labels, no grid. All aircraft seen directly from overhead, noses point straight DOWN / south, engines and exhaust point UP. NO SHIELDS, no surrounding circles, no humanoid parts. First 4 rows = 16-frame idle-flight loop of an aggressive twin-engine cryogenic interceptor: sharply swept angular silver wings, dark navy fuselage, long central pointed nose, small cyan cockpit, TWO heavy side cannons clearly visible, twin compact blue-white engine jets at rear. Last 4 rows = 16-frame idle-flight loop of a DIFFERENT broader ice bomber: broad diamond wing planform with cutaway tips, squat armored navy central hull, three cyan rear engine vents, twin fat rectangular torpedo magazines, silver leading edges and tiny blue armor strips. Make each recognizable aircraft rather than small generic blobs. Each aircraft's metal hull, cockpit and nose stay perfectly fixed in scale, x/y and orientation throughout its 16 frames. Animate only small turbine blades inside exhaust housings, drawn rear thruster flames with 16 distinct shapes, little cyan reactor lights cycling, short vapor wisps. NO rotating the entire ship, NO banking, no drifting between cells, no stretch/squash. Make final frame return smoothly to first. Black outlines, crisp pixel clusters, gleaming silver pixels, readable dark grooves, strong contrast. Never render colored background. Keep all flame tips within every cell, margin for every pose. No muzzle firing in idle loop.
